ComposeHttp.description: A container port served at its own URL, like a service with `http`.

healthcheck.description: A path that answers 2xx once the container serves, like `/`.

port.description: The container port that serves HTTP, like `8025`. It does not need to be published.

service.description: The Compose service. Default: the key.

subdomain.description: The URL prefix, as in `http`. Leave it out on the one service that gets the environment's own URL.

wildcard.description: Also send every subdomain of this service's host to it.

Data.description: Literal paths under PARCELA_DATA_DIR. Nothing is included by default.

file.description: The Compose file, relative to the checkout root, like `docker-compose.yml`.

http.description: HTTPS URLs for containers that serve HTTP, keyed by service name like services with `http`. Their Compose services start too.

services.description: The Compose services to start. The service is ready once each one runs and, if it has a healthcheck, is healthy.

command.description: A shell command, run from the checkout root. HTTP services listen on `127.0.0.1:$PORT`. Required unless the service has `compose`.

compose.description: Runs containers from a Docker Compose file instead of `command`, with their own names, ports and volumes in every environment.

depends_on.description: Services to start, and wait for, before this one.

healthcheck.description: For services without `http`: a shell command that exits 0 once the service is ready.

http.description: Gives the service a port in `$PORT` and an HTTPS URL.

stop.description: A shell command that stops what `command` started outside its own processes, like `docker compose stop`. It runs when the environment stops, before the service is signaled, even if `command` already exited.

working_dir.description: A directory relative to the checkout root to run `command` in.

command.description: A shell command, run from the checkout root. A nonzero exit stops `up`.

depends_on.description: Services to start, and wait for, before the hook runs.

Hooks.description: Commands that prepare an environment. Each runs after the services in its `depends_on` and before every other service.

prestart.description: Runs on every `up` and `restart`, after `setup`. Run migrations.

setup.description: Runs on the first `up` of an environment, and again with `up --setup`. Install packages, create and seed the database, copy secrets.

teardown.description: Runs on `parcela rm`, after the environment stopped. Drop its database or delete outside data. It cannot use `depends_on`.

healthcheck.description: A path that answers 2xx once the service is ready, like `/up`.

subdomain.description: The URL prefix: `https://<subdomain>-<environment>.localhost`. Leave it out on the one service that gets the environment's own URL.

wildcard.description: Also send every subdomain of this service's host to it, like `https://kobe.shop.localhost`, for subdomain-per-tenant apps.

command.description: A shell command, run from the checkout root. Arguments after `--` are appended.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the task after this many seconds and exit 124.

description:
`parcela.yaml` as written. Every field has one spelling and one shape.
Reference: https://parcela.run/docs/configuration/

data.description: Allowlisted data files/directories and SQLite databases under PARCELA_DATA_DIR.

env.description: Variables for every service, hook and task. Values can use `${NAME}` for any variable Parcela sets.

ports.description: Extra ports to lease per environment, exported as `PARCELA_PORT_<NAME>`.

project.description: The project name, used in every URL: `https://<project>.localhost:1443`.

readiness_timeout_seconds.description: How long `up` waits for every service to be ready, in seconds. Time spent in hooks does not count. Default 60.

services.description: Every long-running process, keyed by name.

tasks.description: Commands to run with `parcela task NAME`.
